Method of Attack: Attackers reuse deleted package identifiers to target existing users of the package.
Attack Vector: Exploiting the reuse of deleted package identifiers

Method of Attack: Attackers hijack maintainers' accounts to gain control of packages and distribute malicious versions.
Attackers register deleted GitHub accounts to hijack package redirection and perform download hijacking.
Attackers exploit synchronization issues in mirror sites to override internal packages with malicious ones.
Attackers upload malicious packages with the same name but different case sensitivity to confuse mirror sites and downloaders.
